excluded_attempts.label: haar300-a
excluded_attempts.reason: No stream frames before the new server trusted the Quest; excluded from bitrate comparison.

conclusions: No monotonic fresh-submission improvement from 300 to 600 Mbps. The final 300-Mbps repeat exceeds both higher-rate cells, so a bitrate benefit is not established.
All four new source-identity windows are valid; no PyroWave cell sustains the requested 90 Hz. Median decode-to-fence remains approximately 17.6-18.4 ms against an 11.11-ms frame interval.
The four cells match recorded build, configured/negotiated dimensions and refresh, and debug options apart from bitrate. This is not proof that every external compositor state matched.

visual_review.visible_content: Stereo chart and changing content are present, with SteamVR dashboard and performance HUD covering parts of the image.
visual_review.limitations: Screenshots and lossy compositor recordings are separate from rate captures. Occlusion, lens/compositor transforms and capture transfer behavior prevent exact source pixel scoring. Dashboard visibility was not independently logged during the four rate captures. Repeat a clean overlay-free control before any game/quality promotion.

prior_functional_checks: Head/controller tracking and audio were previously owner-confirmed; not repeated during this AFK session.
